TreeHouse Foods is included as a second-order private-label acquirer with direct relevance through Farmer Brothers' non-direct-store-delivery business. Domino's is included only as a reference/context anchor because its vertically integrated food supply-chain model shows why restaurant systems may value scaled procurement and distribution, but it is not primarily a coffee/beverage supplier. The underfollowed lane includes TreeHouse Foods as a private-label coffee capacity owner, Farmer Bros. as a micro-cap DSD coffee/tea/equipment-service supplier to foodservice accounts, and Coffee Holding Co. as a speculative micro-cap wholesale/private-label coffee supplier.
